name: programming font host eval
command: cd /home/davr/.config/dendritic && echo "=== NIXPC HM home.packages (fonts only) ===" && nix eval --impure --json --apply 'c: builtins.filter (n: builtins.match ".*(oswald|jetbrains-mono|orbitron|source-serif).*" n != null) (builtins.map (p: p.name) (builtins.head (builtins.attrValues c.home-manager.users)).home.packages)' .#nixosConfigurations.NIXPC.config 2>&1 | grep -v "^Using saved\|^warning:" | tail -2 && echo "=== fontconfig.enable ===" && nix eval --impure --json --apply 'c: (builtins.head (builtins.attrValues c.home-manager.users)).fonts.fontconfig.enable' .#nixosConfigurations.NIXPC.config 2>&1 | grep -v "^Using saved\|^warning:" | tail -1 && echo "=== ASAHI ===" && nix eval --impure --json --apply 'c: builtins.filter (n: builtins.match ".*(oswald|jetbrains-mono|orbitron|source-serif).*" n != null) (builtins.map (p: p.name) (builtins.head (builtins.attrValues c.home-manager.users)).home.packages)' .#nixosConfigurations.ASAHI.config 2>&1 | grep -v "^Using saved\|^warning:" | tail -2
